layout_select_when: A supplied portrait, scene, photograph, or image-derived fragment must remain recognizable while supporting a title-dominant cover.
layout_dominant_mass: title first; one image field provides the narrative surface
layout_forbidden_relationships: identity anchors divided across unrelated focal zones
mask used as a UI card
layout_title_zone: one exposed, faded, or low-detail cut inside or beside the image field
layout_object_slot: one recognizable image field, portrait fragment, or scene crop preserving 2–4 identity anchors
layout_collision_rule: title overlaps a low-detail image region or occupies a shaped mask; never cover the primary identity anchor
layout_crop_rule: crop decisively for title hierarchy while retaining 2–4 identity anchors; intrinsic text is preserved when identity-bearing and subordinate
layout_required_structure: paper or atmosphere entering the image
layout_thumbnail_test: title reads first and the supplied subject remains identifiable without the caption
subject_assembly_count: one coherent subject, object, image field, or abstract field
subject_mass_rule: Treat the single subject as one complete, cropped, fragmented, or field-like mass according to the Composition Contract.

composition_operators.definition: Use one recognizable image field and one protected mask or low-detail cut for the title.
Attach at least three major or support elements to one shared edge, axis, baseline, or curvature.
Cut one shaped quiet field into the subject or atmospheric mass.

composition_sentence: TITLE_MASS + SINGLE_OBJECT + IMAGE_MASK + NEGATIVE_SPACE_CUT + RELEASE_ZONE + SHARED_ALIGNMENT
render_treatment_definition: Preserve local object color, material evidence, and product separation; let the palette surround and support the subject.
render_color_rule: Original local colors remain identifiable. Environmental color may appear in shadows and highlights but cannot become the object's new base color.
scale_role_behavior: The subject and title share primary attention through counter-space, tangent, or one common axis.
screen_state_definition: The selected subject has no generated screen behavior.
screen_rendering_rule: Do not add a display, interface, glow, or control surface merely to make the subject look technological.
intrinsic_artifact_text_policy: It is not designed poster copy and is not automatically cropped. Preserve it when identity-bearing and safe; keep it subordinate and never replace it with invented legible text. Hide or soften it only when it competes with the title, contains sensitive or unsuitable information, or cannot be rendered faithfully. Generated SCREEN_CARRIER copy is explicitly excluded: it remains designed copy and counts toward the carrier text budget.
focal_event: A pale panel, atmospheric cutout, or exposed field enters the primary mass and creates a shaped quiet zone.
release_zone: the cut itself or the field it opens
focal_event_thumbnail_test: the quiet shape is visible when the text is mentally removed
derived_tints: derive pale, mid, and soft-deep tones only from the active hues
saturation_rule: allow only one saturation focus; render all other hues as softened fields, haze, or translucent layers
gradient_direction: diffuse light spreads along an asymmetric soft horizon
primary_form: one supplied image field or cropped image fragment preserving the subject's identity anchors
primary_form_placement: authoritative layout object slot: one recognizable image field, portrait fragment, or scene crop preserving 2–4 identity anchors; use the side complementary to the lower-left title zone only when that heuristic remains compatible with the slot; preserve the supplied subject's 2–4 identity anchors; apply crop rule: crop decisively for title hierarchy while retaining 2–4 identity anchors; intrinsic text is preserved when identity-bearing and subordinate; apply scale role INTEGRATED_HERO: The subject and title share primary attention through counter-space, tangent, or one common axis.; resolve SUBJECT_ASSEMBLY SINGLE_OBJECT: Treat the single subject as one complete, cropped, fragmented, or field-like mass according to the Composition Contract.

hero_object.geometry: one supplied image field or cropped image fragment preserving the subject's identity anchors
hero_object.material: selected supplied-image treatment with exposed atmosphere and crisp title edges; Plastic, glass, metal, rubber, screen, and paper remain visibly distinct.
hero_object.lighting: preserve the supplied subject's defining light and expression; do not add a competing hero light
hero_object.placement: authoritative layout object slot: one recognizable image field, portrait fragment, or scene crop preserving 2–4 identity anchors; use the side complementary to the lower-left title zone only when that heuristic remains compatible with the slot; preserve the supplied subject's 2–4 identity anchors; apply crop rule: crop decisively for title hierarchy while retaining 2–4 identity anchors; intrinsic text is preserved when identity-bearing and subordinate; apply scale role INTEGRATED_HERO: The subject and title share primary attention through counter-space, tangent, or one common axis.; resolve SUBJECT_ASSEMBLY SINGLE_OBJECT: Treat the single subject as one complete, cropped, fragmented, or field-like mass according to the Composition Contract.
hero_object.title_relationship: title locks tightly to the image field while preserving 2–4 identity anchors
hero_object.identity_anchors: preserve 2–4 subject-specific identity anchors from the supplied image
hero_object.role_scale_rule: The subject and title share primary attention through counter-space, tangent, or one common axis. The supplied image owns the focal attention; do not add a discrete abstract hero.
hero_object.subject_mass_rule: Treat the single subject as one complete, cropped, fragmented, or field-like mass according to the Composition Contract.

spatial_assignment: obey the layout collision rule: title overlaps a low-detail image region or occupies a shaped mask; never cover the primary identity anchor Place the title and supplied image field or atmospheric primary form in the returned relationship; same-side placement is allowed only for a clear portal opening, counter-shape, framing, or negative-space relationship that preserves both forms
title_clear_zone: the union of visible title glyph silhouettes plus a calm buffer of about 4% of canvas width; the primary form's solid silhouette, luminous core, and highest-contrast edge must stay outside it; soft low-contrast atmosphere may pass behind only when glyph edges and thumbnail readability remain crisp
primary_form_clearance: CATEGORY_LABEL outlines, ANCHOR, ECHO, and decorative lines must not cross the primary form's core contour, highest-contrast region, or visual center; place them along an outer edge, tangent, or extended axis instead
collision_resolution: preserve approved wording and readable title scale; use balanced reflow when suitable, otherwise translate or modestly scale the primary form; never preserve centered placement at the cost of glyph clearance

detail_roles.echo: 2 much smaller thin rings echo instance(s)

detail_limits: one accent language plus at most one hairline bridge; accents under 2% combined canvas area
detail_grammar: one ANCHOR, zero or one BRIDGE, and one or two ECHO instances using one returned accent language
alignment_system: first distribute visual weight across complementary regions, then align at least three of title, hero or atmospheric form, panel, label, bridge, and accents through a shared edge, axis, tangent, baseline, or curvature; the relationship may span the canvas and must not stack all high-information elements in one region
